source_read: https://www.saladproject.co.uk/pages/food (robots Allow /, downloaded 2026-10-10, sha256 3bc7008a2a3c29820ffdaf0e2d932b57bb238c2c1c4c5146a3368d63ab9cd62b) and the chain's live guide https://absolutelysaladproject.com/uk/menu, /uk/menu/<id> and /uk/allergens (linked from every dish card as 'Full Breakdown' and from the FAQ as 'our latest allergen and dietary information guide'; robots Allow /), read in Chromium as a visitor sees them
not_verifiable: The item pages' visible nutrient table is recomputed from per-100 g figures, so 15 of 120 visible cells differ from the stored per-portion figure by 0.1-0.2 (last digit; e.g. Middle Feast salt 4.62 stored vs 4.7 shown); the stored figures are the ones the food page prints and are published. kJ and serving weight are not shown on the item page (stored values only; every kJ is within 3% of kcal x 4.184). The 25 May 2026 allergen PDF was compared once and not used: it disagrees with the food page and the guide for 14 of 15 dishes (the Farm Table is not in it).
notes: All 15 dish versions. (1) Food page: every dish's four printed figures (Calories, Protein, Carbs, Fat) read with a separate regex over the page HTML (not the script's parser): 15 of 15 equal one set of the script's figures exactly. (2) Item pages (rendered text of /uk/menu/<id>): Energy kcal, fat, saturates, carbohydrate, sugars, fibre, protein and salt compared for all 15 (120 cells): 105 equal at the displayed rounding, 15 differ in the last digit as explained, 0 beyond 0.25 kcal / 0.11 g. (3) Allergens: the rendered DOM of /uk/allergens (London matrix: X aria-label 'Contains', T 'May contain (trace)', 29 columns incl. the 5 named cereals and 7 named nuts) parsed independently and compared with allergens.csv under the project's key rules: 15 of 15 rows identical (contains, may contain, named cereals, named nuts). Garlic and Alcohol columns are not one of the 14 and are not published.
